# Home Environment Manager v0.6.0b84 — Unified PID calibration and actionable adaptive suggestions

Beta84 builds directly on the tested Beta83 upstream-power safety release, preserving its ≥60-second verified-idle supply cutoff, physical minimum ON/OFF durations, sleep/window interlocks and saved device ownership.

## One authoritative PID calibration method per managed device

The managed device's **PID · Calibration** selector now offers exactly five choices:
- **Manual Kp/Ki/Kd** — the user edits the gains.
- **IMC / λ** — calculate from manually supplied physical process gain, time constant and dead time; the existing Apply Calibration button explicitly saves the result.
- **Cohen–Coon** — alternative calculated tuning from manually supplied model parameters; the existing Apply button explicitly saves the result.
- **Adaptive · Suggest & approve** (default for legacy observe-only settings) — gather verified natural ON/OFF cycles and send the user a reviewable recommendation; never auto-apply it.
- **Adaptive · Automatic** (explicit opt-in) — keep the existing high-confidence, rate-limited automatic Kp/Ki updates.

Only the selected method may write PID gains. The separate Beta82 Passive Adaptation select entity is retired: its previous stored setting is migrated into the unified selector, while an explicitly chosen IMC/Lambda or Cohen–Coon method wins over a simultaneous legacy passive setting. The model/measurement inputs are shown only for the two manually calculated methods, never over the adaptive review UI. Existing manual gains and device settings are retained.

## Native HEM recommendation notification and review

After at least three consistent, controller-owned normal operating cycles with valid feedback, **Adaptive · Suggest & approve** creates a durable per-device pending review and a Home Assistant persistent notification. The notification includes the physical device, measured-cycle count and confidence, **old Kp/Ki/Kd**, **exact next-step gains that would be applied** and the model's longer-term suggested values.

The managed device also exposes real Home Assistant **PID · Approve suggestion** and **PID · Discard suggestion** button entities, and the HEM dashboard renders these as two inline buttons while a review is pending. Persistent HA notifications do not themselves provide native interactive buttons. For specifically configured HA Companion mobile targets, HEM sends a push notification with **Approve/Discard** action buttons and a unique, one-time proposal token. There is no blanket notification broadcast to all phones.

- **Approve:** Only the shown conservative next-step Kp/Ki gains are saved (bounded approximately ±10% per update, Kd unchanged). HEM revalidates source and room context, selected calibration method, current physical OFF and HVAC activity, controller power ownership, in-flight commands, and unchanged old gains **both before and after the save boundary**.
- **Discard:** The proposal is marked discarded, old gains remain unchanged, and its notification is cleared.
- Old, discarded, superseded or expired (48-hour) tokens cannot authorize a later change. If the physical device is still running or other safety evidence is uncertain, approval is held without altering the gains; retry when the device is safely OFF.
- A new validated cycle may generate a fresh proposal; source/preset/target changes invalidate the previous model context. Manual or classical calibration supersedes any pending adaptive suggestion.

Adaptive automatic retains the Beta82 hard requirements of at least five high-quality natural cycles, 24-hour minimum between gain updates, at least two new cycles between repeated updates and independent safety/ownership checks. No method makes additional test pulses, forces equipment cycling or bypasses a hardware dwell limit.

## Validation and migration

The release workflow validates all 38 shipped translation catalogs, exact five-choice method exclusivity, native Home Assistant review buttons, real browser dashboard behavior, notification action tokens, approval/discard replay safety, changing room targets, native HVAC activity, physical output ownership, legacy PID computation, passive response identification, supply minimum ON/OFF protections, sleep/window constraints and HA event handling. Live operation on the user's own hardware remains a separate acceptance check.

## Installation

Update the **existing** Home Environment Manager through HACS to **v0.6.0b84** and restart Home Assistant; hard-refresh the HEM dashboard. Under each managed device, open **PID · Calibration** and choose a single method. Adaptive suggestions show persistent HA notifications and a pending review on the device; mobile push action buttons additionally require explicitly selected Companion mobile notification targets. No new physical device or relay is enabled automatically.
